axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Traces are excellent ('bank at 40% · no way ← foes on every side'), but chrome jargon kept me guessing: 'default 16% · chores 84%', a statue shown as '−$1130 · forge', 'watch kill' that first did nothing then read 'not held', two-step buttons ('ok ◆2') with no hint.

The forecast made thresholds real trade-offs: bank at hp<50% 'death 0% · avg $628/run' vs 40% 'death 75% · avg $6105/run'; the retreat fix 'survives 12/12' yet 'reach D34 11→0% · death 30→59%'. Lapse: forge/legacy purchases are a strictly ordered buy-everything ladder.

Learned boss counters across the hour (strength for the warlord, mirror read for the foundry master, depth-gated silence after it was wasted on the D8 warlord 'silence scroll · silent'). Lapse: the 'TRY'/fixes list hands over most answers, so discovery is mostly reading.

Watched the D33 king at Normal: 'DRINK HEAL', '−10 hp · king', my own 'HP 31% → bank' at 18/57 hp; deaths cost carry ('kept $0 · $2533 lost'). But most outcomes resolved offline with nothing I carried at stake beyond the run.

My rows are recognisable ('foe: boss · depth ≥ 25 → read silence', bank rows) atop a 'Guarded reader' package, but the report says 'picked 29% · taught 3% · chores 69%' — most of the behaviour is the package's.
'Found heir 5's bones: 7 items' then the next heir downed the Mirror King; eight heirs in one hour make a lineage. The reel is terse and most runs are 'D23 · collected'.
